title: 淡江大橋工程
summary: 以單塔不對稱斜張橋認識載荷路徑、施工階段、耐久性及長期監測。
summaryEn: Study load paths, construction stages, durability and monitoring through a single-pylon asymmetric cable-stayed bridge.
scope: 公開原理的分層工程教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務，並非原廠配方、施工圖或操作許可。
scopeEn: A layered course in public engineering principles. Steps are verifiable learning tasks, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, or operating authorization.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「淡江大橋工程」的「界定交通與環境需求」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「跨河橋梁試載日」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Define transport and environmental needs” in “Danjiang Bridge Engineering”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Bridge proof-test day” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 哪個敘述最直接說明「界定交通與環境需求」的核心原理？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains define transport and environmental needs?
options: 橋梁服務需求包括交通、航道與環境，不能只以跨距衡量。
地形、地質、水文與風場會影響結構選型。
主橋、引道與基礎的介面需要一致的座標和標高。
optionsEn: Bridge requirements include traffic, navigation and environment, not span alone.
Topography, geology, hydrology and wind influence structural choices.
Main span, approaches and foundations need consistent coordinates and elevations.
quiz.explanation: 橋梁服務需求包括交通、航道與環境，不能只以跨距衡量。
quiz.explanationEn: Bridge requirements include traffic, navigation and environment, not span alone.
